%c[pda_white]Absolver%c[ui_gray_1] requires completing the Deadly Sin storyline. 
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
This achievement is available only in Story mode. 
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
The Sin faction becomes available to the player.

%c[pda_white]Tinkerer%c[ui_gray_1] requires crafting 50 items. 
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
Specialized kits can be found in stashes or on stalkers. Some include recipes and instructions for broader use. 
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Many advanced recipes will require fewer components to craft items.

%c[pda_white]Bookworm%c[ui_gray_1] requires unlocking every guide article in the PDA.
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
You can unlock articles in various ways, such as talking to characters or downloading data from memory sticks.
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Rare PDAs will appear in place of memory sticks.
 
If new articles are added after you earn this achievement (by a mod or patch), the effect will be temporarily disabled so memory sticks can still be obtained.

%c[pda_white]Collaborator%c[ui_gray_1] requires completing the Operation Afterglow storyline. 
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
This achievement is available only in Story mode. 
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
The International Research Group faction becomes available to the player.

%c[pda_white]Completionist%c[ui_gray_1] requires earning every Raid into Darkness achievement.
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
This achievement is available only in True Darkness mode.
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Gain +1000 rank points.

%c[pda_white]Flak Gunner%c[ui_gray_1] requires destroying either 3 helicopters with firearms or 1 with explosives such as an RPG or RG-6 Bulldog. 
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Mi-24 helicopters are replaced with Mi-2s.

%c[pda_white]Vanguard%c[ui_gray_1] requires disabling both psi installations, at Yantar and Radar. 
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
After the psi emitters are disabled, navigation through Yantar and Radar becomes much easier.

%c[pda_white]Geologist%c[ui_gray_1] requires detecting at least 50 artifacts with a detector. 
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
Finding an artifact requires using a detector. 
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Artifacts in anomaly fields will spawn slightly faster.

%c[pda_white]Entrepreneur%c[ui_gray_1] requires having 1,000,000 rubles. 
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Most traders begin offering rarer, special goods that would otherwise require maximum reputation with their faction.

%c[pda_white]Child’s Play%c[ui_gray_1] requires smashing 200 wooden crates. 
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
You will likely unlock this achievement during normal play. Crates can be found in almost every location, especially in industrial areas. 
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Wooden crates have a 25% chance to contain more items.

%c[pda_white]Info Dealer%c[ui_gray_1] requires turning in at least 50 PDAs to information traders. 
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
PDAs can be found on dead stalkers. 
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Information traders will buy PDAs at a higher price.

%c[pda_white]Invictus%c[ui_gray_1] requires doing the nearly impossible:
%c[d_red] • %c[ui_gray_1]Play in Story mode and complete the Lost in the Zone storyline.
%c[d_red] • %c[ui_gray_1]One Life mode must be active from day one until the storyline is complete.
%c[d_red] • %c[ui_gray_1]Play at the highest game and economy difficulty without changing modifiers.
%c[d_red] • %c[ui_gray_1]Do not die twice in one playthrough.
%c[d_red] • %c[ui_gray_1]Do not use Debug Mode.
 
Enjoy the game!

%c[pda_white]Iron Curtain%c[ui_gray_1] requires your faction to dominate the Zone by capturing half of its territories. 
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
This achievement is available only in Faction War mode. 
Underground levels do not count. 
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
A large cash reward is given as a trophy.

%c[pda_white]Killer%c[ui_gray_1] requires killing 5 hostile NPCs with a pistol in under 2 minutes.
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
Pistol kills count toward the total.
 
%c[pda_red]Conditions%c[ui_gray_1] 
You must not disguise yourself as a member of another faction.
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Unlocks some %c[pda_white]SMGs%c[ui_gray_1] and %c[pda_white]sawed-off shotguns%c[ui_gray_1] for the knife and pistol slots. 
 Receive coordinates for 1 %c[255,255,215,28]Personal%c[ui_gray_1] stash in the middle belt.

%c[pda_white]Gunsmith%c[ui_gray_1] requires delivering all 3 toolkits to any technician.
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
Toolkits are most often found in stashes, especially those revealed by leads, but sometimes on other stalkers.
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Extra items gained when repairing equipment become much more effective.

%c[pda_white]Dark Spirit%c[ui_gray_1] requires completing all three storylines in One Life mode. 
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
This achievement is available only in Story mode. One Life mode must remain active for the entire playthrough.

%c[pda_white]Expert%c[ui_gray_1] requires reaching the Expert rank. 
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Receive coordinates for 2 %c[255,255,215,28]Personal%c[ui_gray_1] stashes in the middle belt.

%c[pda_white]Legend%c[ui_gray_1] requires reaching the Legend rank. 
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Receive coordinates for 3 %c[255,255,215,28]Personal%c[ui_gray_1] stashes in the northern belt.

%c[pda_white]Master%c[ui_gray_1] requires reaching the Master rank. 
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Receive coordinates for 2 %c[255,255,215,28]Personal%c[ui_gray_1] stashes in the northern belt.

%c[pda_white]Veteran%c[ui_gray_1] requires reaching the Veteran rank. 
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Receive coordinates for 1 %c[255,255,215,28]Personal%c[ui_gray_1] stashes in the middle belt.

%c[pda_white]Local Hero%c[ui_gray_1] requires reaching the highest possible rank.
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
Rank points and rank itself can be earned through almost any action.
The guide also contains an article explaining how ranks work.
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
You can hire two additional companions beyond the usual limit.

%c[pda_white]Marked One%c[ui_gray_1] requires surviving 25 emissions and 25 psi-storms.
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
Emissions and psi-storms occur at random, but you can adjust them in the game's weather settings.
 
Emissions and psi-storms can be enabled or disabled at any time, but they must be enabled to earn this achievement.
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
A small chance to survive an emission or psi-storm without shelter.

%c[pda_white]Pathfinder%c[ui_gray_1] requires looting (even partially) at least 100 stashes.
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
Stashes can be found almost anywhere and at any time, but stashes revealed by leads are marked on the map.
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
The maximum number of items in fresh stashes is slightly increased.

%c[pda_white]Reaper%c[ui_gray_1] requires killing 10 hostile NPCs with firearms in under 2 minutes.
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
This achievement is available only in True Darkness mode.
You can use any firearm.
 
%c[pda_red]Conditions%c[ui_gray_1] 
You must not disguise yourself as a member of another faction.
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Receive coordinates to 3 %c[255,255,215,28]Personal%c[ui_gray_1] stashes in the northern belt.

%c[pda_white]Junk Collector%c[ui_gray_1] requires dismantling 200 items. 
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
Most items can be dismantled into basic materials. Dismantling requires a multitool and/or a Swiss knife. The guide has a detailed article on the subject. 
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
You have a 33% chance to obtain an extra part when dismantling.

%c[pda_white]Savage%c[ui_gray_1] requires killing 3 giants with melee weapons.
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
This achievement is available only in True Darkness mode.
It has no time limit.
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
You receive coordinates to 5 %c[255,255,215,28]Personal%c[ui_gray_1] stashes in the northern belt.
 
%c[ui_gray_2]This is tough!

%c[pda_white]Butcher%c[ui_gray_1] requires killing 8 boars with melee weapons.
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
There is no time limit.
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Receive coordinates for 2 %c[255,255,215,28]Personal%c[ui_gray_1] stashes in the middle belt.

%c[pda_white]Marauder%c[ui_gray_1] requires either 500 stalker kills or 50 stalkers who have surrendered.
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
You will likely unlock this achievement during normal play. To get it sooner, avoid killing neutral or friendly stalkers if you care about your reputation.
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Surrendered stalkers may reveal an additional stash lead.

%c[pda_white]Raid Pro%c[ui_gray_1] requires completing 35 raids with few deaths.
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
This achievement is available only in True Darkness mode.
 
%c[pda_red]Conditions%c[ui_gray_1] 

 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Receive coordinates for 3 %c[255,255,215,28]Personal%c[ui_gray_1] stashes in the northern belt.

%c[pda_white]Night Raider%c[ui_gray_1] requires completing 5 night raids.
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
A raid counts as a night raid if it takes place between 22:00 and 04:00. Travel time does not count.
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Receive coordinates for 2 %c[255,255,215,28]Personal%c[ui_gray_1] stashes in the middle belt.

%c[pda_white]Sixth Sense%c[ui_gray_1] requires completing 6 tasks in a single raid.\\n \\n%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] \nYou receive coordinates to 2 %c[255,255,215,28]Personal%c[ui_gray_1] stashes in the same belt where you earned the achievement.

%c[pda_white]Scout%c[ui_gray_1] requires visiting all 33 locations in the Zone. 
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Receive coordinates for 3 unique stashes.

%c[pda_white]Duty Commando%c[ui_gray_1] requires at least 1200 reputation with Barkeep.
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
You need to improve your reputation with Barkeep.
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Purchase and sale specialization bonus: 6%.

%c[pda_white]Skinflint Companion%c[ui_gray_1] requires at least 1200 reputation with Skinflint.
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
You need to improve your reputation with Skinflint.
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Purchase and sale specialization bonus: 6%.

%c[pda_white]Heartless%c[ui_gray_1] requires at least 1200 reputation with No Data.
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
You need to improve your reputation with No Data.
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Receive coordinates for 4 %c[255,255,215,28]Personal%c[ui_gray_1] stashes in the northern belt.

%c[pda_white]Research Institute Employee%c[ui_gray_1] requires at least 1200 reputation with Professor Sakharov.
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
You need to improve your reputation with Professor Sakharov.
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Purchase and sale specialization bonus: 6%.

%c[pda_white]Right Hand of Sidorovich%c[ui_gray_1] requires at least 1200 reputation with Sidorovich.
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
You need to improve your reputation with Sidorovich.
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Purchase and sale specialization bonus: 6%.

%c[pda_white]All in Your Stride%c[ui_gray_1] requires at least 1200 reputation with every trader.
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
You need to improve your reputation with all 5 traders who give tasks.
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Bonus to purchase and sale specialization for all traders: 25%.

 
%c[ui_gray_2]This is tough!

%c[pda_white]True Expert%c[ui_gray_1] requires reaching the Expert rank on high difficulty.
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
This achievement is available only in True Darkness mode.
Rank information is available in the Features section, in the Rank article.
 
%c[pda_red]Requirements%c[ui_gray_1] 
%c[d_red] • %c[ui_gray_1]Play on the highest game and economy difficulty without changing modifiers.
%c[d_red] • %c[ui_gray_1]Do not use Debug Mode.
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Receive coordinates to 3 %c[255,255,215,28]Personal%c[ui_gray_1] stashes in the middle belt.

%c[pda_white]True Legend%c[ui_gray_1] requires reaching the Legend rank on high difficulty.
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
This achievement is available only in True Darkness mode.
Rank information is available in the Features section, in the Rank article.
 
%c[pda_red]Requirements%c[ui_gray_1] 
%c[d_red] • %c[ui_gray_1]Play on the highest game and economy difficulty without changing modifiers.
%c[d_red] • %c[ui_gray_1]Do not use Debug Mode.
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Receive coordinates to 4 %c[255,255,215,28]Personal%c[ui_gray_1] stashes in the Dark Zone.
 
%c[ui_gray_2]Respect from Shabash!

%c[pda_white]True Master%c[ui_gray_1] requires reaching the Master rank on high difficulty.
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
This achievement is available only in True Darkness mode.
Rank information is available in the Features section, in the Rank article.
 
%c[pda_red]Requirements%c[ui_gray_1] 
%c[d_red] • %c[ui_gray_1]Play on the highest game and economy difficulty without changing modifiers.
%c[d_red] • %c[ui_gray_1]Do not use Debug Mode.
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Receive coordinates to 3 %c[255,255,215,28]Personal%c[ui_gray_1] stashes in the northern belt.

%c[pda_white]True Veteran%c[ui_gray_1] requires reaching the Veteran rank on high difficulty.
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
This achievement is available only in True Darkness mode.
Rank information is available in the Features section, in the Rank article.
 
%c[pda_red]Requirements%c[ui_gray_1] 
%c[d_red] • %c[ui_gray_1]Play on the highest game and economy difficulty without changing modifiers.
%c[d_red] • %c[ui_gray_1]Do not use Debug Mode.
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Receive coordinates to 2 %c[255,255,215,28]Personal%c[ui_gray_1] stashes in the middle belt.

%c[pda_white]Ninja%c[ui_gray_1] requires spending a total of 5 hours undercover among stalkers. 
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
You can disguise yourself by wearing faction gear. The guide contains articles with more details. 
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Stalkers will be less suspicious of your actions.

%c[pda_white]Hunter%c[ui_gray_1] requires either 500 mutant kills or 250 mutant parts harvested. 
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
Mutant butchering is much faster.

%c[pda_white]Skeptic%c[ui_gray_1] requires completing the Living Legend storyline. 
 
%c[pda_green]Information%c[ui_gray_1] 
This achievement is available only in Story mode. 
 
%c[pda_blue]Effect%c[ui_gray_1] 
The Renegade faction becomes available to the player.
